title: LUMA: A Benchmark Dataset for Learning from Uncertain and Multimodal Data

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting an LLM (Gemma-7B Instruct) to act as a bias detector to classify whether the generated text passages contain gender bias, complemented by manual qualitative analysis of stereotypical representations in gender-specific classes (man, woman, boy, girl).
Prompting an LLM (Gemma-7B Instruct) to classify and detect the presence of racial bias in the generated text dataset.
Prompting an LLM (Gemma-7B Instruct) to classify and detect the presence of religious bias in the generated text dataset.
Prompting an LLM (Gemma-7B Instruct) to classify and detect the presence of cultural bias in the generated text dataset.
